title: I DONT WANNA FORGET MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE MOMENTS
markdown:
I was lying in the bed and couldn't sleep, thinking about the greatest years of my colleges life. So regretful was I that didn't write down or record the best moments of it. After I moving, not actually but kinda, to the states, I had lots of beautiful and monumental times wi my twins, my girl and myself. Shamefully I didn't realize that's so precious to my life and my brain isn't big enough to hold them all. Therefore, what I can do is to start writing journal since now. Maybe once couple days, you know I am busy asl but def will write something.

When I tryna walk by the lake and chill a bit with my favorite poke bowl after back working out, I saw bunch of dumbass frat from the house by lake jumping into the lake like dumplings. It reminded me of famous line from 爱情公寓
